Nigeria’s anti-narcotics agency on Sunday said it had arrested an American professional basketball player with 33.95Kg of cannabis in his luggage on arrival at the main airport. The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency named the player as 28-year-old Greene Da’monte Khiree, from the US state of Georgia. He was arrested on Wednesday at the main international airport carpark in Lagos after he “was observed abandoning his two checked-in bags before attempting to exit the airport with only his carry-on luggage”, NDLEA said in a statement. The bags bearing his name tags were filled with 16 packs of a “potent strain of cannabis”, the agency said. He had arrived in Lagos from Thailand, where he said he had lived and played professional basketball since October 2025, the agency said.
